name: seller.draft.galleryReplace
title: Profile: seller.draft.galleryReplace
description: Canonical profile for replacing the gallery of an existing seller draft.
text:
# seller.draft.galleryReplace

TL;DR:
- Use this when upload ids already exist and you want the draft gallery to match final image order.
- Existing gallery items are replaced.

This profile is for finalizing or reordering draft images.
whenToUse: The seller wants to replace or reorder the draft gallery.
recommended: Send the upload ids in the desired final order.
Preserve the returned gallery state for later confirmation.
avoid: Do not pass raw CDN URLs instead of upload ids.
Do not expect append semantics; this replaces the gallery order.
exampleInterpretation: The returned gallery is the new canonical ordered gallery for the draft.
